sections.title: Summary
sections.text: Full-stack developer with **2+ years** of experience building React/TypeScript frontends, FastAPI and Node.js backends, and serverless AWS infrastructure across freelance, startup, and research environments. Engineered the frontend for IRESI's RENEWchallenge project, selected for prize-phase funding under Ireland's National Challenge Fund. Implemented multi-tenant SaaS platforms, real-time IoT monitoring systems, AI-integrated data pipelines, Stripe payment flows, and event-driven architectures.

items.label: Cloud & DevOps
values: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, CDK, SQS, SES, S3, CloudWatch)

bullets: Built a multi-tenant POS system for picture framing shops with WordPress REST API, jQuery frontend, and AWS serverless backend (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, SES), deployed via CDK with single-table design and DynamoDB Streams-to-SQS-to-Meilisearch search pipeline

Developed a user discovery and age estimation SaaS with FastAPI and React, orchestrating a multi-stage pipeline across AWS Rekognition, OpenAI GPT-4o, Playwright scraping, and Google Lens reverse image search with configurable accuracy levels

Built a web scraping platform with FastAPI, Playwright, and GPT-4o for automated content discovery (RSS, CSS crawling, AI), extraction, original article generation, and SEO automation across **7 API modules** and **10+ external integrations**

Developed a real-time multiplayer quiz game with React 19, Node.js/Express, Socket.IO, and PostgreSQL; supporting quiz and impostor game modes with WebSocket-driven state sync, Levenshtein answer validation, and mobile-first UI
Delivered the RenewEnergy (renewenergy.io) IoT energy monitoring platform; React frontend with Plotly.js data visualizations for real-time power consumption tracking and historical energy analytics
Developed FastAPI backend endpoints and device management UI for RenewEnergy, enabling user-facing tariff comparison, location hierarchy, and multi-device monitoring

Developed the AI-EFFECT portal with React, TypeScript, and FastAPI; AI service management, solution composition with connection validation, and atomic AI4EU package import across **25 REST endpoints** with full-text search
Designed async Python backends with SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL across both platforms, with Alembic migrations, JWT authentication, and Docker Compose deployment
Contributed to ViziDrive (vizidrive.eu), a B2B SaaS platform, building Node.js/TypeScript microservices and React frontends with PostgreSQL and Stripe payment integration
Created **2** React-based admin dashboard and public portal with Material-UI, MobX, and event-driven microservice communication via SQS
Developed REST APIs with FastAPI and Node.js, improving response times through query optimization, database indexing, and refactoring
Implemented reusable React component libraries using Material-UI and TypeScript, standardizing UI patterns across multiple applications

items.note: İzmir, Turkey; GPA 3.70. Awarded merit-based scholarship for 3 consecutive years
